**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Propagate GraphQL failures while resolving review SHAs**

When a clean review/comment contains an abbreviated SHA and the `Resolve` request fails because `gh` times out, returns GraphQL errors, or emits malformed data, this handler converts the operational failure to `None`. `check()` consequently writes a `findings` or `incomplete` result and exits 0, even though the new collection contract says any `gh` failure must abort with exit 2; callers can therefore mistake a failed evidence collection for a successfully collected gate result. Preserve `None` for a successful null/non-Commit response, but let `RuntimeError` propagate.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
